scope: direct image review of GCP2-generated full2Hz triplets and every10Hz tail sheet; videos verified with ffprobe only; no Mac GUI

timeline: 0–2s self views turn away from initial beam; r1 sees nearby partner
2–22s r1 keeps partner/body prominently in view; r2 sees beam obliquely
22–54s repeated small view shifts without completing approach; neither both-finger assigned grasp nor lift
54–60s r2 moves toward teal close-up; r1 still looks at partner/ground; cap_end
student_failures.dense_vs_sparse: 10Hz tail shows persistent slow camera/body motion, not a single brief frame occlusion. No high-frequency oscillation asserted.
student_failures.cause_limit: target signed gap is not an identified blocking obstacle. Training start coverage mismatch is an observed protocol gap, not a proved causal explanation.

timeline: 0–4s r1 approaches visible blue and r2 approaches visible teal, opposite their tokens
4–10s both color bands expand toward bottom of each own image
10–14s bands leave frame and beam face fills views
14–18.9s beam held with fingers at opposite-assigned endpoints; both students signal done; settles and exits as failure
student_failures.dense_vs_sparse: All10Hz tail sheets show continuous close-up and sustained hold; sparse end frames could mistake any-beam lift for assigned success.
student_failures.cause_limit: Wrong assignment is supported jointly by plan tokens, visible band colors and evaluator-only contact positions; no claim that color recognition itself is the unique learned failure.

teacher_reference.kind: prior beampair8 teacher success, separate reference; never added to student n/20
timeline: 0–3s r2 teal end stays visible and waits; r1 initially searches
3–12s r1 turns and approaches blue while r2 waits at teal
12–17s both settle at their assigned colors
17–23s arms pick; bands leave field of view and beam fills own images
23–24.5s both complete; overview remains at opposite ends
teacher_reference.comparison: own close-up filling with beam is not alone evidence of wrong end; assignment must be checked against tokens/contact ledger
